title: Apollo 11: Catching Some Sun
explanation:
# Moon's First Footprints

On July 20, 1969, Neil Armstrong captured Buzz Aldrin unfolding a shiny foil sheet on the Moon's dusty surface—a clever trap designed to catch invisible particles streaming from the Sun, giving scientists their first direct sample of solar material. Along with 22 kilograms of Moon rocks brought back to Earth, this solar wind collector revealed secrets about our Sun that could only be discovered by venturing beyond our planet.
